cohort: Patients admitted for medication abortion due to genetic or anatomical abnormalities between 22+0/7 and 30+0/7 weeks gestation, from 2014 to 2022.
finding: The mifepristone-misoprostol regimen was associated with a shorter time to fetal expulsion and shorter duration of hospitalization compared to the misoprostol-only regimen for medication abortion.
mod_finding: The mifepristone-misoprostol regimen resulted in a shorter time to fetal expulsion compared to the misoprostol-only regimen for medication abortion.
